note: the page and its assets, the store profile and layouts, the Google and accounts-mailbox sign-in walks, and the status page, with their routes

areas.name: rendering
areas.doc: The page: splitting the one page into its shell, stylesheet and script, rendering the shell, its ETag, the packed and hashed assets (the composer among them), the frame headers that pin the page to the shop's admin, and the build id. Moved out of copilot.py (stage 4 of the 14 October audit); its routes, the page's own and its assets, are in gizmo/routes/rendering.py. Read as `rendering.NAME`.

areas.name: profile
areas.doc: The store profile: what the merchant tells the assistant about the store, kept and handed to every answer. Moved out of copilot.py (stage 4 of the 14 October audit); its route is in gizmo/routes/profile.py. Read as `store_profile.NAME` (`profile` is a local name in the overview).

areas.name: layouts
areas.doc: Page layouts: how each person has arranged the cards on a report screen. Moved out of copilot.py (stage 4 of the 14 October audit); its route is in gizmo/routes/layouts.py. Read as `layouts.NAME`.

areas.name: oauth
areas.doc: The sign-in walks: the one-time states, the redirect address and the page every walk answers with (the inbox's and Xero's walks read them from here), and the accounts mailbox's tickets. Moved out of copilot.py (stage 4 of the 14 October audit); the Google and accounts-mailbox walks' routes are in gizmo/routes/oauth.py. Read as `oauth.NAME`.

areas.name: status
areas.doc: The status page's workings: the store report, the last error alert and the token vault's state. Moved out of copilot.py (stage 4 of the 14 October audit); its routes, the status page and the health check, are in gizmo/routes/status.py. Read as `appstatus.NAME`.

routes.name: routes_rendering
routes.doc: The page's routes: the page itself and its three assets. Gathered from add_routes (stage 4 of the 14 October audit) where the first stood; their paths are literal, so no request changes hands.
